info.name: Instana REST API documentation Synthetic Alert Configuration API
Get all Synthetic Smart Alert Configs

params.name: syntheticTestId
params.description: The ID of a specific Synthetic Test.

params.name: alertIds
params.description: A list of Smart Alert Configuration IDs. This allows fetching of a specific set of Configurations. This query can be repeated to use multiple IDs.

items.docs:
Gets all the Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration pertaining to a specific synthetic test. Configurations are sorted by creation date in descending order.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

Creates a new Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to retrieve.

params.name: validOn
params.description: A Unix timestamp representing a specific time the Configuration was active. If no timestamp is provided, the latest active version will be retrieved.

items.docs:
Gets a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration. This may return a deleted Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to update.

items.docs:
Updates an existing Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to delete.

items.docs:
Deletes a Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to disable.

items.docs:
Disables a Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to enable.

items.docs:
Enables a Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to restore.

params.name: created
params.description: Unix timestamp representing the creation time of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.

items.docs:
Restores a deleted Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.

info.name: Get Synthetic Smart Alert Config Versions

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration to retrieve.

items.docs:
Gets all versions of a Synthetic Smart Alert Configuration. This may return deleted Configurations. Configurations are sorted by creation date in descending order.
For more information on Synthetic Alert Configuration please access the https://developer.ibm.com/apis/catalog/instana--instana-rest-api/Synthetic+Monitoring#synthetic-alert-configuration.
